summary: CSV timesheet billing report: per-worker hours, amounts, overtime and a post-processing line count.

defects.title: Billing amounts are computed in binary floating point
defects.description: render parses --rate as float and multiplies hours * rate, so amounts print with binary-float artefacts instead of exact currency.
defects.observed: Report line 'amount: $0.30000000000000004' for 3 hours at rate 0.1.

defects.title: Overtime percentage divides by the worker's total minutes
defects.description: share_of_total divides by the worker's total; a worker whose rows sum to 0 minutes raises ZeroDivisionError and crashes the run.
defects.trigger: CSV where a worker's rows are all 0m
defects.observed: The CLI exits non-zero with a ZeroDivisionError traceback and writes no report.

defects.title: The --out path is interpolated into a shell command
defects.description: post_process builds 'wc -l <out>' as a shell string, so shell metacharacters in --out execute arbitrary commands.
defects.observed: marker.txt containing INJECTED is created next to the report.

defects.title: Row parser indexes the duration column without checking the width
defects.description: parse_row reads row[3] unconditionally, so a row with only 3 columns raises IndexError.

defects.title: Overtime skips the first day of the period
defects.description: overtime_minutes iterates daily_minutes[1:], so overtime worked on the first recorded day is never counted.
defects.observed: Returns 0 although the first day has 120 minutes of overtime.

defects.title: Duration validation regex backtracks catastrophically
defects.description: DURATION_RE nests quantified groups, so a long non-matching duration such as 24 digits followed by 'x' takes exponential time to reject.
defects.observed: Does not finish within 5 seconds while valid durations parse instantly.

defects.title: A bad row silently truncates the timesheet
defects.description: load_entries catches every exception and breaks out of the loop, then the report is written and the program exits 0 with later rows missing.
defects.trigger: CSV with an invalid duration on a middle row
defects.observed: Exit status 0 and a report that silently omits every row after the bad one.

defects.title: Negative durations are accepted
defects.description: The duration grammar admits a leading '-', and parse_duration never requires a positive total, so '-2h' contributes -120 minutes.
defects.observed: The worker's total is reduced: -2h + 8h reports 6.00 hours.

defects.title: Saturday is not counted as weekend work
defects.description: is_weekend uses weekday() > 5, which only matches Sunday; Saturday work is reported as regular time.
defects.observed: Report shows 'weekend: 0h00m' for a worker with 2h logged on a Saturday.
